values: 比诸神与恶魔更加古老的星海化身，以恒星昭示降临，以黑洞吞噬万物。
An ancient being from the Sea of Stars, heralding its arrival with blazing stars and devouring all things with black holes.
The power of the stars converges within me.
To think I would come to ruin...
In the vast sea of stars, dust fades to nothing.
Witness the cosmos and all creation.
I descend. I witness. I devour.
All things... will ultimately become one.
Listen... to the whispers from the depths!
其有深渊之息，某心生欣慰。
It bears the aura of the abyss. That pleases me.
This mortal creation... is worthy of a closer look.
Light does nothing but provoke revulsion.
An ideal vantage point for observation.
凡人诸般行径，甚为有趣
凡人赖以为生之物委实多样
Mortals rely on a fascinating variety of sustenance...
一位神明曾说过：“星比所有恶魔、所有神明都更加古老，甚至可能比伊索米亚这颗星球诞生得更早。”
"Aster is older than all Hypogeans and gods, perhaps even Esperia itself," a god once said.
虽然身为恶魔，同样为创造了他的伟大存在效忠，但星几乎从不作恶。然而，他的出现往往就预示着灾祸即将来临。
Despite being a Hypogean loyal to the great being who created him, Aster rarely commits evil. That said, his presence often heralds impending disaster.
据贝利尔所说，出现在伊索米亚的星不过是一个投影，真正的星藏在星海最深暗的角落。
According to Berial, the Aster seen in Esperia is merely an apparition of his true self, which lies hidden in the darkest reaches of the Sea of Stars.
星很少表露情绪，无论是被人崇拜还是受人诋毁，他都全然不在意。毕竟，没有任何一句话语能够撼动一位源于星海的恶魔。
Neither admiration nor insult can stir Aster, who rarely shows emotions. Words are too insignificant to affect him.
有许多狂热的天文学家和星象爱好者会向星祈祷，想见一见这位传说中由星体化成的恶魔，却很少有人能如愿。但他们不知道的是，从向星祈祷的那一刻开始，他们就已经成为了星的观察目标。

Many ardent astronomers and stargazers pray to Aster for a chance to meet him, but few ever have their wish granted. Little do they know: from the moment their prayers are spoken, they themselves fall under Aster's watchful gaze.
星的身体是模仿着凡人的样子幻化而出的，据说他这样做是为了“防止自己看起来像是凡人幼童手中的拍打玩具”。
Aster fashioned his physical form after mortals, supposedly to avoid resembling a toy that might attract mortal children.
由于星所讲述的语言太过古老晦涩，很多时候，连他的同类也无法理解他在说什么。
Even Aster's fellow Hypogeans struggle to understand him because he speaks an archaic language.
星并不喜欢伊索米亚。这颗星球渺小、多彩、生机盎然，还充斥着令人不快的各类气体。
Aster sees little appeal in Esperia, for the planet is too tiny, colorful, and vibrant for his taste, and filled with all sorts of unpleasant gases.
在星看来，凡人极其不懂得欣赏：当太阳落山，露出浩瀚无垠的星空，他们竟然不珍惜眼前的美景，彻夜欣赏，反而相继进入睡眠，简直是暴殄天物。
Aster is utterly baffled to see mortals go to sleep whenever the magnificent starry sky reveals itself after sunset. To him, it is clear proof that they have no sense of appreciation.
曾经有几个不谙世事的孩童指着星大喊“天外之人”，星思考了很久这种认知究竟正确还是错误，最终将其定义为无法作答的哲学问题。
Some children once called Aster "the stranger from the sky". Aster spent a long time pondering whether the label was accurate, ultimately concluding it was a philosophical question with no answer.
Elijah. Lailah. Companions from an age long forgotten.
